description: Search the HelloBooks public knowledge base and return citable document ids. Covers pricing plans, AI credit allowances, integrations, per-country features and compliance frameworks, statutory filing deadlines, local payment methods, competitor positioning, the marketing feature catalog, and published articles on hellobooks.ai. Returns `{ results: [{ id, title, url }] }`; pass an `id` to `fetch` for the full document. No customer or account data is reachable through this server.

query.description: Natural-language query, e.g. "HelloBooks GST filing for India" or "pricing vs Xero".

name: search
title: Search HelloBooks public knowledge
